title: Dawnstead - The Lullaby in Full
_note: Anchor / dawn payoff. gbc 4-voice, no chords. 100 BPM, 4/4, C major, radiant, NO minor turn. Reprises Tinderwick A's Lantern Lullaby melody WHOLE but confident, mid-tempo - the wistful A-minor answer now resolved to a glowing C-major answer. Same town, same melody, finally in daylight. Vesper motif = the FULL BLOOM, the lift finally reaching the sky. Harmony = the old music-box arp opened into a flowing harp-like ascending arp (Light sparkle). Bass = warm walking root-motion (the hearth pulse grown into a confident stride). Percussion = gentle present groove, soft kick/brush, warm fill at seam. 16-bar loop (the lullaby's own length, in daylight) ~38s.

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: Tinderwick's lullaby reprised whole, confident in major. Vesper full bloom: G3->C4->D4 lift ... E4->D4->C4 settle, the lift now reaching higher (up to G4/C5). The former A-minor B section now glows in C major (C-E-G / F-A-C / G). Final bar leans on G (V) into bar 1.

tracks._note: Flowing harp-like ascending arpeggio (Light sparkle) - the old music-box opened up. Broken triads rolling upward, eighths. C, F, G, Am following the bass; all resolving bright.
